name: hf_abdomenatlas_mini
title: AbdomenAtlas 1.0 Mini: abdominal CTs with nine organ masks (first 100 of 5 195 cases)
description: AbdomenAtlas 1.0 Mini (Johns Hopkins): 5 195 CT volumes with nine abdominal organs annotated, per case a CT, a combined label map and one mask per organ. The repo is gated: accept its terms on huggingface.co and log in (HF_TOKEN); the package then fetches files on access. This manifest lists the first 100 cases explicitly (no repo listing needed); edit the sample list or use pl.load('hf://AbdomenAtlas/AbdomenAtlas1.0Mini/BDMAP_00001234') for others.

license.note: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, gated repository (checked 2026-10-14): non-commercial, share-alike, your own Hub token after accepting the terms.

citation: Qu C., Zhang T., Qiao H., et al. AbdomenAtlas-8K: Annotating 8,000 CT Volumes for Multi-Organ Segmentation in Three Weeks. NeurIPS 2023. Li W., et al. AbdomenAtlas: A large-scale, detailed-annotated, & multi-center dataset for efficient transfer learning and open algorithmic benchmarking. Med Image Anal 97:103285, 2024.
